claims.text: Run the deterministic DSS v0 context-selection pipeline.
claims.why: The docstring claims determinism, but the implementation uses rename_map (a dict) which in Python 3.6+ preserves insertion order; however, the docstring does not specify that the pipeline is deterministic under the same inputs. The code does not guarantee determinism if rename_map is not ordered. Additionally, the pipeline calls external functions (build_forest_hierarchy, carry_temporal_scores, etc.) whose determinism is unknown. Therefore, the claim cannot be fully verified from this chunk.
